Re-Identify Pseudonymized Text Using a Local Mapping Vault

Source: R/pii.R
pii_reidentify.Rd

Restores original values for <<TYPE_HASH>> pseudonym tokens using an in-memory airgap_pii_vault or a vault file saved on disk via pii_vault_save().

Usage

pii_reidentify(text, vault, key = NULL, cols = NULL)

Arguments

text

Character vector (or data frame when cols is supplied) containing pseudonymized strings.

vault

An airgap_pii_vault object, an airgap_pseudonymized object, or a file path to a saved vault file.

key

Optional secret key required when vault is a path to an encrypted vault file.

cols

Optional character vector of column names to re-identify when text is a data frame. Defaults to all character columns.

Value

A character vector (or data frame) with matching pseudonym tokens restored to their original values.

Examples

key <- pii_vault_key()
orig <- "Patient: Jane Doe (jane@example.org)"
res <- pii_pseudonymize(orig, key = key)
identical(pii_reidentify(res$text, res$vault), orig)
#> [1] TRUE
